title: biznes.mu Pocket Guide
line: Mauritius, place by place: places to see and things to do, region by region. Every fact from an official source.
priceNote: The owner's price, 20 November 2026: Rs 150 an edition. There is one guide, renewed every month (the owner, the same day: "i suggest 1 big guide, like a biznes.mu pocket guide"); the bundle of many guides proposed earlier is set aside.
